payload.title: Resume deferred local portfolio runs automatically
payload.description:
As an operator, I want a locally launched portfolio run to resume its own scheduled publication retry, so that a transient artifact-publication interruption cannot leave the run overdue indefinitely.

Out of scope: general account-wide task dispatch, schema changes, automatic promotion, and exposing sensitive artifact identifiers or provider error content.

Feature: Targeted continuation of a deferred local run

Scenario: The exact deferred run resumes when due
Given a locally launched portfolio run has durably deferred a retry for a UTC time
And the original execution process exits
When the retry time becomes due
Then a targeted continuation process rearms and executes only that exact Procedure and Task
And the run continues from its durable checkpoint

Scenario: An unrelated pending task is not executed
Given other account tasks are pending
When the targeted continuation becomes due
Then only the exact deferred parent Task is claimed
And no account-wide pending-task scan is used

Scenario: A publication interruption preserves resumable evidence
Given a milestone publishes many verified artifacts
When publication is interrupted after a partial batch
Then the verified descriptors are durably indexed in bounded batches
And the retry reuses verified artifacts instead of uploading them again

Scenario: Failure telemetry remains safe and useful
Given milestone publication raises an exception
When the run records a retryable publication failure
Then it records the exception class, operation category, completed count, total count, and retry classification
And it records no artifact names, keys, opaque resource IDs, or content
